what: Explanation of how to set up project-local hooks for OpenCode and agy CLI via .agents/hooks.json.
why: The user asked for specific indications on setting up project-local hooks for OpenCode and agy CLI.
learned: Project-local hooks in Antigravity are configured by creating `.agents/hooks.json` in the project root directory. Both OpenCode (IDE) and agy (CLI) automatically discover and load this file when working in the project workspace, but they differ in product-specific paths (e.g. transcriptPath uses antigravity-ide vs antigravity-cli) passed via stdin to hook commands.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
